system.description:
“Ever changing / moving on now, moving fast”

Proteans are not only survivors, they are the pinnacle of adaptability and tactical flexibility. The Protean often acts as the spearhead of a unit: the first one to go in – and the last one to go down. Their abilities were shaped by their lives: Some trained under military doctrine, learning to adapt within rigid command structures, while others were forged by necessity on the fringes of explored space, where survival rewarded flexibility over a fixed skill set. A Protean can be a soldier, an assassin, a mercenary, or a remote explorer on a strange alien world… and the next day they change their role again.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v2.0 Mind

backgroundQuestions: Who first taught you how to adapt — and how did you later surpass their lessons?
What hostile world or battlefield once tried to break you — and how did it leave its mark?
What flaw in your survival method do you fear an enemy could exploit?
Whose life did you save by abandoning the plan — and do they still trust you?
What rule of survival guides you above all else — and what would make you break it?
connections: You once followed my lead through hostile ground. What made you trust my path over your own?
I shared my last resource with you when survival was uncertain. What mark did that choice leave on you?
You saw me change the plan in the middle of a fight. Why did you stay with me instead of breaking away?
I asked you to adapt to my strategy. What did it cost you to follow?
You know the weakness in how I survive. Why do you never use it against me?
